detail.title: Admit one bounded executable STEM/NLP primitive with a versioned contract
detail.description:
Purpose: advance recorded input9 from STEM/NLP phrase themes to an executable primitive with a precise machine contract.

Current boundary: production pattern forms are lit/ref/alt/seq; the18 catalog fragments remain phrase/data declarations. The current progression audits existing obligation algebra. A literal-substring witness reference, if present in research evidence, is not a production Op or general NLP competence.

Acceptance criteria:

* Select one bounded operation from the reviewed research contract and explicitly state the supported domain.
* Serialize its version, structural input/output relation, human-readable meaning, mathematical definition, effects, cost unit, source identity, and unresolved limits.
* Implement through the existing headless machine architecture; preserve exact original input strings, catalog declarations, and existing APIs.
* Verify positive, negative, boundary, invalid, zero-budget, and exhausted-budget behavior against an independent oracle. Exhaustion must never become a false negative claim.
* Record actual composition behavior and declared obligations; separate executable evidence from lexical/semantic truth and broader generator mining.
* Update live operation/reference coverage and source-pinned evidence only after implementation.

Starting sources: src/core/20-primitives.js; src/core/30-language.js; src/core/43-obligations.js; docs/progression/mathematical-contract.md; docs/progression/research-support.md.
